body:
The edit (✎) button on a web item row is a small btn-icon (0.35rem padding), so
its tap target is barely the glyph — easy to miss on touch. Enlarge it to cover
the complete right corner of the row: stretch to full row height and reach the
card's right/top/bottom edges (negative margins cancelling the card padding),
with generous horizontal padding for width.
title: Web item rows: enlarge the edit hitbox to the whole right corner, not just the pencil glyph
